what: Why this is faster than the API
title: Bulk-downloading ACS 5-year data
text: 244,000 block groups U.S. Pulling 16 tables nationwide via Census API mean tens thousands paginated requests, API key, rate limits. get_acs_new() 16 large file fetches – one per table – lets data.table::fread() parse one seconds. residential connection full block- group pull typically 3-10 minutes wall-clock, ~zero second run caching.

what: Why those two tables get dropped
title: Bulk-downloading ACS 5-year data
text: C16001 (detailed languages spoken) B18101 (disability) published tract resolution . EJSCREEN repeats tract values onto blockgroup tract; need behavior, fetch separately: join block-group table afterwards tract substring fips.

title: Bulk-downloading ACS 5-year data

title: Get full USA ACS data by table and fips (table-based summary file format) — get_acs_new
text: tables vector ACS data table codes like "B01001" "C17002". Race/ethnicity-suffixed (e.g. "B03002H") Puerto Rico Community Survey tables (e.g. "B05001PR", "B06004APR") also accepted. EJSCREEN tables published tract resolution (notably "C16001" detailed languages spoken home "B18101" disability); return_list_not_merged = FALSE fips = "blockgroup", tables filter zero rows dropped merge warning. fips one : single geography type name: "blockgroup", "tract", "county", "state", "city", "REGION", "MSA", "CSA", "Urban Area", "Congressional District", "ZCTA", "American Indian Area/Alaska Native Area/Hawaiian Home Land" ("blockgroup", "tract", "county", "state", "city" well-tested); vector fips codes (width / geography type). Numeric codes normalized canonical Census widths (e.g. 1001 becomes "01001"). geography level inferred code width applied SUMLEVEL filter results mixed across levels share code suffix; 5-digit code treated county (ZCTA). pull ZCTAs, use fips = "ZCTA". NULL row filtering. yr end year 5-year ACS summary file (e.g. 2024 2020-2024 survey released Census Bureau Jan. 2026). Validated acsfirstyearavailablehere (floor) current_year + 1 (ceiling); bad values fail HTTP call. fiveorone 1 5; 5-year sample tested . return_list_not_merged TRUE (default) return named list one data.table per requested table; FALSE, merge tables fips return single data.table. cache_dir optional path directory persist downloaded .dat files. table-based SF files immutable vintage ships, caching safe dramatically speeds repeat calls. Defaults getOption("ACSdownload.cache_dir", NULL). timeout_sec per-request timeout seconds .dat download. Defaults getOption("ACSdownload.timeout", 300). max_retries number retry attempts first transient HTTP failures (HTTP 429 5xx). Defaults getOption("ACSdownload.retries", 3). parallel TRUE future future.apply installed, fetch .dat files concurrently. caller must set future::plan() first. variables optional character vector specific estimate variable codes keep, like c("B25034_001", "B25034_002"). Names matched post-rename form (_E infix). NULL (default), estimate columns requested tables kept. keep_moe TRUE (default), keep margin--error columns (<table>_M<nnn>); FALSE, drop . keep_annotations TRUE, keep annotation columns (<table>_EA<nnn>, <table>_MA<nnn>) vintages include; default FALSE drops . quiet FALSE (default) cli package installed, show progress bar (sequential) downloads. Ignored parallel = TRUE.

title: ACSdownload 3.0.0
text: get_acs_old() every helper supported sequence-file format (downloading, parsing, geo-file parsing, NHGIS helpers, lookup tables, etc.) removed. 47 source files dozen .rda data objects deleted. Minimum R version bumped 4.0. acsfirstyearavailablehere: 2018 -> 2022 (floor get_acs_new() can target). acsdefaultendyearhere: 2023 -> 2024 (2020-2024 ACS vintage, released Census Bureau 2026-01-29). ejscreen_acs_tables updated mirror EJAM::tables_ejscreen_acs (authoritative list) ACS2024 branch: 16 entries instead 15, adds B17017, replaces legacy B28003 B28002. Code ejscreen_acs_tables[1:13] skip tract-tables now wants setdiff(ejscreen_acs_tables, c("C16001", "B18101")) ([1:14]). data.table now properly declared Imports: (NAMESPACE); magrittr removed Imports: (unused).

title: ACSdownload 3.0.0
text: cache_dir (default ) – persist .dat files; subsequent calls instant. Recommended: tools::R_user_dir("ACSdownload", "cache"). timeout_sec (default 300) – per-request timeout. max_retries (default 3) – retries HTTP 429 / 5xx. Optional parallel downloads. parallel = TRUE fetches via future.apply::future_lapply() future future.apply installed; caller responsible setting future::plan(). Fail-fast input validation. Bad table codes, bad fips arguments, bad years rejected HTTP call, helpful messages. Variable selection. New variables, keep_moe, keep_annotations arguments let trim columns fetch time. acs_label() – exported helper turns variable codes (e.g. "B01001_001") human-readable labels, parent table titles, population universes. Backed new bundled lookup acs_table_shells (28,331 rows, parsed official Census 2022 5-year Table Shells file). acs_endyear_like_ejam() – exported helper returns latest ACS 5-year end year Census Bureau published. Prefers EJAM’s acs_endyear() EJAM installed (resolved dynamically EJAM’s namespace, works whether build exports ), falling back self-contained estimator otherwise. Progress + quiet. get_acs_new(quiet = FALSE) shows cli progress bar sequential downloads cli installed. get_acs_old() now defunct shim: instead “find function”, callers get clear error pointing get_acs_new() v2.4.0-pre-refactor tag.

title: ACSdownload 3.0.0
text: Requests vector fips codes now constrained geography level inferred code width, just code suffix. fips code’s width can collide across Census levels (5-digit county vs 5-digit ZCTA share suffix), get_acs_new(fips = "01001") previously returned Alabama county Massachusetts ZCTA two legislative districts. fips-code path now ANDs suffix match inferred SUMLEVEL, returning single geography level. 5-digit code treated county; use fips = "ZCTA" pull ZCTAs. 11-digit FIPS codes now disambiguated instead always assumed tracts (instead unconditional “ambiguous” warning). 11-digit value can complete tract 12-character blockgroup lost leading zero. fips_lead_zero_acs() now resolves deterministic state-FIPS heuristic (blockgroup loses leading zero state code 01-09, one reading usually plausible); e.g. Connecticut blockgroup "90010201001" restored "090010201001". rare case readings plausible (e.g. state-40 tract vs state-04 blockgroup) defaults tract, authoritative tract list can passed via new tract_fips argument (.ejam_tract_fips() supplies EJAM::blockgroupstats’s tract list EJAM installed). Values whose first digits valid state either reading become NA. Numeric fips codes lost leading zeros now normalized filtering. get_acs_new(fips = 1001) previously validated "1001" matched rows, GEO_ID-derived fips carry zeros ("01001"). validate_fips_arg() now restores canonical Census widths via fips_lead_zero_acs(), coerces numeric input format(scientific = FALSE) large codes don’t become e.g. "1e+05". Codes impossible digit widths rejected clear message; -width (single geography type) check runs normalization. Puerto Rico Community Survey tables (PR-suffixed variants, e.g. B05001PR, B06004APR) accepted . input validator added 3.0.0 rejected download even though files exist shipped table shells include IDs; table-code pattern now allows optional PR suffix, estimate/MOE/annotation column patterns used variables / keep_moe / keep_annotations filtering. get_acs_new_geos() returned zero rows filtering geography type name (e.g. fips = "county"). Geos sidecar file stores SUMLEVEL integer (50), sumlevel_from_fipstype() returns zero-padded string ("050"), filter never matched. comparison now numeric. (Bug present since function added; caught new live integration test.)

title: ACSdownload 3.0.0
text: Source code split concern R/get_acs_new.R, R/geos.R, R/fips.R, R/sumlevel.R, R/labels.R, R/defaults.R, R/utils-download.R, R/utils-validate.R. R/url_acs_table.R longer carries duplicate fipstype_simplified() / fips_lead_zero_simplified() helpers; uses canonical ones R/fips.R. New tests/testthat/ suite: 92 expectations covering helpers, validators, defaults, label lookup, column filter, download layer. R CMD check: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes. .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml – standard r-lib/actions matrix macOS, Windows, Ubuntu (release + oldrel-1). 5.6 MB inst/ACS20225YR_Table_Shells.txt source file moved data-raw/, installs longer carry .
